title: Deeper/broader Autodesk VIEW/SUN API contract refresh
mode: primary-source review and plan clarification; research only
scope: Reconcile VIEW DXF group 361 with the AcDbSun hard-owner contract
Check whether AcDbViewTableRecord exposes a SUN association API
Define the minimum native evidence needed before admitting VIEW 361 on output
Keep VPORT/VIEWPORT generated structural results distinct from VIEW semantics

sources.observed: VIEW group 361 is described as the Sun hard ownership ID.
AcDbSun is documented as a hard-owned child of AcDbViewportTableRecord or AcDbViewport, with setSun/sunId APIs on those viewport classes.

sources.revision: Autodesk ObjectARX 2019 AcDbViewTableRecord method index, viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The method list includes setSun and sunId, but linked detailed method pages were unavailable in this pass.
A read/write SunId property exists on the abstract view-record API. It establishes an association surface, not whether a VIEW record is the SUN database owner.

sources.revision: Autodesk ObjectARX 2027 AcDbViewport method index, viewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The viewport API independently exposes setSun and sunId.

method.limitations: The linked detailed AcDbViewTableRecord setSun/sunId pages were not available from the indexed sources. No native producer drawing was generated or inspected, so the exact VIEW-to-SUN owner relation and erase/deletion behavior remain unresolved.

assessment.planImpact: Corrects the prior implication that VIEW has no SUN API association. VIEW exposes setSun/sunId through its abstract base, while the AcDbSun ownership page names only VPORT/VIEWPORT hard owners. Keep VIEW code 361 fail-closed until a native save proves object owner, handle serialization, and deletion/share behavior; proceed with unrelated local work.
